purpose: Accuracy screen for a moderate token-sparse MambaTS v3 architecture after the stride-32 speed/accuracy failure.
research_question: Does patch_stride=24 retain enough temporal resolution to recover PEMS07 H12 accuracy while keeping the measured forward path below the modern neural baselines?
selection_history: The architecture was fixed before these seeds from the resource probe: patch_stride=24, d_model=16, d_ff=32, d_state=8, d_conv=2, expand=1. The stride-32 validation failure is not used to tune these seeds.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory architecture probe on PEMS07 H12. No test metric is generated, inspected, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: A favorable result only justifies a four-PEMS confirmation matrix; it is not a publication or general time-series claim.
prelaunch_gates: verify PEMS07 fingerprint, M feature geometry, and train-only normalization contract
freeze stride-24 MambaTS v3 active/null graph and dimensions
retain the fixed resource probe as the efficiency evidence

phases.name: pems07_h12_mambatsv3_stride24_autocon_null
phases.purpose: Exact stride-24 AutoCon graph with lambda zero.

phases.name: pems07_h12_mambatsv3_stride24_autocon_active
phases.purpose: Exact stride-24 AutoCon graph with lambda 0.001.

primary_contrasts: candidate versus historical PEMS07 TimeMixer mean
comparison_contract.resource_contract: Use the fixed synthetic PEMS07 B32 L96 C883 H12 probe already run for stride-24 d16.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: No test-set, all-PEMS, long-horizon, or general time-series claim is permitted.

stopping_rules: Do not change architecture, lambda, seeds, or budget after launch.
If candidate mean is more than 1% worse than historical TimeMixer, stop this route.
If active/null is not directionally reproducible, make no causal AutoCon accuracy claim.
Do not release test metrics from this probe.
